fullPassage: In the escape that reading literature provides through vicarious identification and comparison with other lives, places, and times, we activate our imagination, that uniquely human ability to explore an alternative set of ideas and experiences that are outside our present environment and that may not even be real. As opposed to perception that receives and processes information from the outside world — light, sound, shape — and finds meaning in it — a sunset, a symphony, a house — in imagination, the process is reversed. Translating the words we read into what they signify, we populate an inner world in which imagery is created from the memory. For example, we read "house" and picture a representation of a house from memory. It is our imagination, the complex interweaving of perception and memory that literature activates, releasing a latent creativity that pleases. The writer may provide the blueprint, but the reader builds literature's many rooms, and like any satisfying occupation, literature gratifies our imaginative and creative abilities.

❌ ② that → what: into what they signify = 그것들이 의미하는 것으로
✅ ③ created: is created = 수동태
✅ ④ builds: 단수주어 reader에 맞는 3인칭 단수

✅ ② 지각과 상상은 동일한 방식으로 정보를 처리한다: 원문은 process is reversed — 반대 과정
❌ ① 원문 일치: 문학은 대리 동일시를 통한 도피 제공
❌ ③ 원문 일치: 상상력은 지각과 기억의 복합체
❌ ④ 원문 일치: 문학은 상상력과 창의적 능력을 만족시킴
det.tip: process is reversed = 과정이 역전됨 (동일하지 않음)

ch: 문학은 대리 동일시를 통한 도피를 제공한다.
지각과 상상은 동일한 방식으로 정보를 처리한다.

questions.passage: In the escape that reading literature provides through vicarious identification and comparison with other lives, places, and times, we activate our imagination, that uniquely human ability to explore an alternative set of ideas and experiences that are outside our present environment and that may not even be real. As opposed to perception that receives and processes information from the outside world — light, sound, shape — and finds meaning in it — a sunset, a symphony, a house — in imagination, the process is reversed. Translating the words we read into what they signify, we populate an inner world in which imagery is created from the memory. For example, we read "house" and picture a representation of a house from memory. It is our imagination, the complex interweaving of perception and memory that literature activates, releasing a latent creativity that pleases. The writer may provide the blueprint, but the reader builds literature's many rooms, and like any satisfying occupation, literature gratifies our imaginative and creative abilities.
questions.stem:
다음 문장이 본문과 일치하면 True, 일치하지 않으면 False를 선택하시오.

"Perception creates imagery from memory, while imagination processes information from the outside world."

det.korean: 원문과 반대로 서술됨. 지각이 외부 정보를 처리하고, 상상이 기억에서 심상을 만든다.
det.analysis: ❌ False: perception = 외부 정보 처리, imagination = 기억에서 심상 생성 → 진술은 둘을 바꿔놓음
det.tip: perception(외부→의미) vs imagination(기억→심상) — 진술은 반대로 서술
